atoms.a: This is a thermometer. Thermometers are used to measure temperature.
atoms.b: This is a thermometer. Thermometers are used to measure ((++temperature colours)).

atoms.a: Temperature is a measure of how much heat something has.
atoms.b: Temperature is a measure of how much ((++heat --money)) something has.

atoms.a: The unit used to measure temperature is called degrees Celsius.
atoms.b: The unit used to measure temperature is called degrees ((++Celsius fractions)).

atoms.a: There is a scale of numbers that goes up the side of the thermometer showing the temperature.
atoms.b: There is a scale of numbers that goes up the side of the thermometer showing the ((++temperature --size)).

atoms.a: The degrees Celsius symbol at the top shows the units of measurement.
atoms.b: The ((++°C --%)) symbol at the top shows the units of measurement.
